beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Dave lays three cards face down again. "Let's see where the guesswork got me."

beats.prompt: The past: the workshop, quietly growing before any of this began.
The present: the commission, and everything already on the table for it.
The future: the instinct you followed before you could explain it.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Okay, quiz me. If listening underneath the request was the right call, why did she come back a third time with more changes?"

options.text: One right read doesn't end the conversation — it just earns you the next one.
It means your first read was wrong after all.
Three rounds means she doesn't trust you.

elaboration: The High Priestess lives on a threshold, not a finish line — reading her underneath once doesn't close the door for good.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "And this 'trust the feeling' thing — how do I know it's actually intuition, and not just me guessing?"

options.text: It doesn't arrive with proof — it arrives quiet, and you test it by building it anyway.
You can't ever know, so stop trusting it.
Real intuition always comes with certainty attached.

elaboration: The High Priestess's light is borrowed and quiet, like the moon's — it was never going to arrive with the Magician's certainty attached.

beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: "One thread ties all three: what's already there, what's already growing, and the quiet read you trusted before you could prove it."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Yeah. I think I've been waiting for the reasoning to catch up before I trust the read at all — and it never does, until after. That actually explains a lot."
